card.name: Invasive crop pest and biocontrol passages
card.fires_on: Words in agricultural pest-control text about invasive insects or weeds, such as beetles, weevils, psyllids and swallow-wort. It fires on digits, linking words and word parts right around the pest's name or its introduction.
